R4F-bear-backcountry-0003.name: By Garrett Creek
R4F-bear-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), 20 m S: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
S facing slope, 27 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Garrett Creek 100 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 69 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.86616, -117.82552, pull off on B 101Br 4.5 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.1 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 519 m, about 174 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 510 m N of the spot at 1,681 m (51.91307, -117.88237). Water: unnamed lake 280 m NW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-40, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R4F-bear-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-40: about 42 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.01 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R4F-grouse-atv-0001.name: By Kinbasket River
R4F-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R4F-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Kinbasket Mainline); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
15 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 55 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.98849, -117.95212, where the truck road ends (Kinbasket Mainline); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Kinbasket Mainline stretch, 4.2 km one way. About 84 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-40, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R4F-grouse-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-40: about 541 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.19 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
